name: meshcentral
description: MeshCentral remote support for Claude Code: inventory, diagnostics, commands, terminals, remote desktop, file transfer, software, Windows registry and chat with the person at a device.

server_url.title: MeshCentral server URL
server_url.description: e.g. https://mesh.example.com (include the domain path if you use one)

token_user.title: Login token user
token_user.description: From My Account > Login tokens in MeshCentral; starts with ~t:. Leave blank to use the settings file below.

token_pass.title: Login token password
token_pass.description: The password half of the login token.

profile.title: Capability profile
profile.description: readonly, support, operations or admin (see docs/PERMISSIONS.md).

insecure_tls.title: Accept a self-signed certificate
insecure_tls.description: Only for a MeshCentral server without a trusted TLS certificate.

env_file.title: Settings file (optional)
env_file.description: A .env file with further MESH_* settings, or MESH_USERNAME/MESH_PASSWORD instead of a token. Values above take precedence.

http_credentials.title: HTTP credentials file (optional)
http_credentials.description: JSON file of named logins for mesh_http_request (LAN web devices). Default: ~/.config/meshcentral-mcp/http-credentials.json if it exists.
